After all these years, and over $10,000 spent on Searchie, we're leaving at the end of April.   
  
If you want a video library experience for members, it has some okay features. Nothing better than a private YouTube membership, to be honest.   
  
It's confusing for members to subscribe and almost impossible for them to cancel. We abandoned paid memberships in Searchie years ago.   
  
Side bar: membership.io is one of the worst names because let's be real having a membership in something called "membership" sounds ridiculous. [...] were helpful, but they haven't kept up with what other platforms now offer. The Searchie transcripts, for example, are still quite horrible, not pulling from the more sophisticated AI that Zoom uses. I still have to go into each and every video in Searchie/membership.io and completely rewrite the autogenerated recording summary. # Membership.io (Formerly Searchie) Review: The Shocking Gaps No One Talks About

Membership.io (formerly Searchie) is a web-based software platform designed for creating, managing, and selling digital content.

It promises to combine your entire content library, community features, and payment processing into one clean digital content platform.

But does it deliver on that promise? [...] ### A Note on the Rebrand: Membership.io formerly Searchie

The platform used to be called Searchie, so the name change to Membership.io tells you everything about their new direction.

They shifted from simply organizing content to building comprehensive membership sites, incorporating stronger community features and intelligent AI tools.

Now you get assistants like the Membership.io Copilot for writing content and the Membership.io AI Chat Plugin for answering member questions automatically.

The platform is owned by Stu McLaren, someone who has actually built successful membership sites himself and knows what works for real online businesses.

Now, let’s proceed to the actual review and discuss the Membership.io community features. [...] The generative AI results provide instant summaries. It’s like having a teaching assistant for your digital courses available 24/7.

This search functionality transforms how people consume your materials. They find answers faster, which means better content consumption and higher satisfaction.

The platform really delivers on making your video and audio content incredibly accessible and valuable for your members.

## Membership.io (Formerly Searchie) Review: Course Creation

Building your online course in Membership.io feels different than traditional course platforms. The approach centers around their unique Hub system rather than a standard course builder.

Each digital course lives inside its own Hub. Think of a Hub as a custom website dedicated to that specific course or membership.

# What is Membership.io?

## Learn what Membership.io is and how it helps you build and grow digital programs

Membership.io is a cloud-based platform that helps creators, coaches, and entrepreneurs deliver digital programs—such as courses, memberships, and coaching—inside organized, private member areas called Hubs. Formerly known as Searchie, the platform centralizes content, community features, payment processing, and analytics, allowing you to manage your programs without needing separate tools.
